departments.why: Nine department names keyed by dept_no; dept_emp and dept_manager both point at it, so it stays unfolded.

dept_emp.why: Which department each employee was in, from from_date to to_date: the employee's state over time, not an occurrence.

dept_manager.why: Who managed each department, from from_date to to_date: the department's state over time.

employees.why: One row per employee keyed by emp_no with names, gender, birth and hire dates (business dates); every other table points at it.

salaries.why: Each employee's salary as of from_date, keyed by emp_no plus from_date; about 6,000 dates across 2.8 million rows, the employee's pay state over time.

titles.why: Each employee's job title as of from_date, keyed by emp_no, title and from_date; about 6,000 dates across 443,000 rows, the employee's title state over time.
